item.text: I’ll trace the Trivy conversion, shared CVE model aggregation, detector library path, and TUI reference rendering. I’ll record a checkpoint first, then make the smallest coordinated changes and run the existing relevant tests.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "find .. -name AGENTS.md -o -name '*trivy*' -o -name cvecontents.go -o -name library.go -o -name tui.go -o -name go.mod -o -name '*_test.go' | head -250"

/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Issue: Preserve Trivy vulnerability metadata separately for each advisory source.

Initial investigation: locating the converter, shared CVE models, detector aggregation, TUI references, and existing tests before editing.
EOF
find . -name AGENTS.md -print; git status --short; find . -path '*/.git' -prune -o \\( -path './contrib/trivy/pkg/converter.go' -o -path './models/cvecontents.go' -o -path './detector/library.go' -o -path './tui/tui.go' -o -name go.mod -o -name '*_test.go' \\) -print | head -200"

item.text: The converter currently overwrites accumulated metadata for a CVE on every target, and both conversion paths collapse all Trivy advisories into one `Trivy` content. I’m checking Trivy’s source and CVSS data shape alongside Vuls’ content aggregation rules so the per-source keys retain all supplied scores and timestamps.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "grep -nE 'type CveContent|type CveContentType|const \\(|Trivy|func \\(.*(Titles|Summaries|Cvss2Scores|Cvss3Scores)|getCveContents|References' models/cvecontents.go tui/tui.go; grep -R -n 'type Vulnerability struct\\|type CVSS struct\\|CVSS' \""'$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/trivy-db@v0.0.0-20240425111931-1fe1d505d3ff/pkg/types" "$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/trivy@v0.51.1/pkg/types" | head -100; grep -R -n '"'func getCveContents\\|getCveContents(' --include='*.go' ."

/bin/bash -lc "grep -nE 'type CveContent|type CveContentType|const \\(|Trivy|func \\(.*(Titles|Summaries|Cvss2Scores|Cvss3Scores)|getCveContents|References' models/cvecontents.go tui/tui.go; grep -R -n 'type Vulnerability struct\\|type CVSS struct\\|CVSS' \""'$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/trivy-db@v0.0.0-20240425111931-1fe1d505d3ff/pkg/types" "$(go env GOPATH)/pkg/mod/github.com/aquasecurity/trivy@v0.51.1/pkg/types" | head -100; grep -R -n '"'func getCveContents\\|getCveContents(' --include='*.go' ."
